infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: THINNR uses Face ID only to unlock the signed-in app on this device.
infoPlist.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: THINNR reads only the weight and step measurements you approve for your patient account.
infoPlist.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: THINNR does not write health data.

plugins.motionPermission: THINNR reads the phone's tilt so guided progress photos line up at the same angle every week.
